scenes.text: How is Bangladesh getting ready for heat?
Bangladesh has daytime hotspots in the west and south-west, and humid heat and warm nights in its crowded cities.
In 2024, heat-related illness cost two hundred and fifty million workdays.
What is in place: a National Adaptation Plan to 2050, a health adaptation plan adopted in 2026, national guidance on heat illness, and a city heat plan in Narayanganj.
From plans on paper to protection people can use.
